1Read the questions and write the answers using ’s or s’.

Example: Whose pencil case is this? (Ali) → It is Ali’s pencil case.

Whose umbrella is this? (Defne) → It is .

Whose trainers are these? (the girls) → They are .

Whose glasses are these? (Kaan) → They are .

Whose car is that? (my uncle) → It is .

Whose necklace is this? (Zeynep) → It is .

Whose football is under the bench? (the boys) → It is .

Whose hoodie is this? (Arda) → It is .

Whose eyes are green? (Elif) → eyes are green.

2Rewrite the sentences using ’s or s’. Use the owner’s name.

Example: The jumper of Emir is green. → Emir’s jumper is green.

The scarf of Selin is pink. → is pink.

The tail of the dog is long. → The is long.

The house of my grandparents is old. → My is old.

The hair of Ece is curly. → is curly.

The bags of the students are heavy. → The are heavy.

The car of my aunt is red. → My is red.
